findings.title: Preserve the test logger's recording state in FromContext
findings.body: FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log buffers on every call. LoggerMiddleware now writes completion logs through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so a TestLogger supplied to that middleware no longer records those messages in its InfoLogs; the logs are written to an inaccessible temporary instance instead. Return the same recorder, or a contextual wrapper sharing its recording state, so callers can still inspect and assert the emitted logs.
